Anya V: Heads-up: onboarding smoke failed on /rerank. Sporadic 400s: "embedding.length mismatch" during batch runs.
Diego R: any repro notes?
Anya V: We use the Go sample-app. Batch helper returns slice views of a big []float32 to avoid allocations. When an auth refresh triggers a retry the HTTP retry queue re-sends the same slice header pointer; later code appends to the backing array and one slice ends up with len 1535 instead of 1536. API returns generic embedding.length mismatch.
Marta S: oh interesting 1 — Go slice headers share the underlying array, so append can mutate other views depending on capacity. Python and JS hit different patterns. Which go-sdk version?
Anya V: go-sdk v0.6.1 in sample-app. Minimal repro snippet:
```go
batches := Batchify(vecs, 8)
for _, b := range batches {
  go sendRerank(b) // sendRerank may enqueue pointer to `b` on auth retry
}
```
Anya V: In the retry case we enqueue the same slice header; downstream append() changes backing array shape and the requeued request ends up with a truncated vector.
Diego R: short-term fix: copy slice contents before enqueueing for retry. Long-term: retry middleware should clone request bodies or mark them immutable so helpers don't need to special-case.
Marta S: agree. Also we should improve the API error to include more diagnostics. "embedding.length mismatch" is too terse. If the error included batch_index, expected_dim and got_dim fields it'd speed triage.
Platform APIs: noted. We can add optional fields to the error payload (batch_index, expected_dim, got_dim) next minor release and keep backward compatibility. SDKs should ignore unknown fields.
Go SDK Bot: created issue go-sdk#989: "retry-middleware: deep-copy body before enqueue to avoid slice-view mutation" and assigned @Diego R.
Anya V: opened a hotfix PR in sample-app that copies batches before enqueue; staging smoke passed. CI green.
CI Bot: PR #8912 pipeline passed \u2705
Diego R: follow-ups: 1) merge sample-app hotfix, 2) implement clone-in-retry-middleware in go-sdk (medium), 3) add E2E parity test across go/js/py for batching+retry, 4) request API error enrichment (coord w/ Platform APIs).
Marta S: small parity wrinkle: server-side dedupe compresses results and we observed ordering differences across SDKs. Requesting the server to include an explicit input_to_output_map when dedupe occurs would let clients remap deterministically.
Platform APIs: we will add optional `input_to_output_map` to rerank responses when dedupe runs. We'll document the change and ask SDKs to consume it when present.
Anya V: also adding a short note to onboarding docs: "Go: avoid reusing slice views for retriable request bodies; clone if the request may be queued."
Diego R: thanks all. Merging hotfix now and tracking middleware + API issues.
